purpose: Representation-control experiment: determine whether R14's same-variable CNF width-6 lower bound disappears when fresh existential extension variables are permitted. This is not a direct-from-frame compiler test.

method.input: The already-exposed exact W05 prime-implicate interface from the independent witness.
method.encoding: Encode every prime clause into an equivalent width<=3 definitional OR-chain using fresh local auxiliary variables. Auxiliary definitions are acyclic and private to each encoded prime clause.
method.semantics: For every bridge assignment b, original_interface(b) iff EXISTS a extended_interface(b,a).
method.verification: Enumerate all 2^16 frozen bridge assignments. Construct the unique topological auxiliary valuation induced by each assignment and verify the encoded CNF directly; compare the resulting allowed set and hash to the frozen exact W05 witness.
